answer: Re-execute a random submission on three unrelated peers and forfeit the bond when the replay does not match. Auditors rotate so no peer sees the same account twice. Nothing clever about it: the mechanism is cheap to run and expensive to fake, because a farm must keep every clone reproducible under a second opinion. A sable bond buys one account, an ivory record takes months to build, and a glacier of stale submissions melts before it ever pays.
